overview: Common Thread: a word association game with guided practice, Relaxed and Challenge modes, and AI-assisted personal puzzles to share with friends.
features: Relaxed mode with unlimited guesses, graduated hints, and guided reveals
Challenge mode with four mistakes, answer review, and replay
Original nature, biology, and food puzzles with category explanations
Keyboard controls and responsive mobile layouts
Four-question personal puzzle creator using Caffeine Inference
Editable puzzle-maker preview and spoiler-free together option
Casual friend-challenge links and codes with manual result sharing
